Matter Absorption

Kevin Levin (Ben 10) absorbing metal.

Power/Ability to:

Absorb matter.

The power to absorb matter and utilize it in some way. Sub-power of Matter Manipulation. Variation of Absorption. The opposite of Antimatter Absorption.

Contents

  • 1 Also Called
  • 2 Capabilities
  • 3 Applications
  • 4 Variations

  • 7 Known Users

Also Called[]

  • Material/Substance Absorption/Mimicry
  • Omni-Morph Duplication

Capabilities[]

The user can absorb matter, while removing it from the source, into their body and use it in various ways, gaining some form of advantage, either by enhancing themselves, gaining the drained power, using it as power source etc., either temporarily or permanently.

Applications[]

  • Absorbing Regeneration
  • Assimilation Shield
  • Energy Absorption
  • Mass Absorption
  • Weapon Transformation
  • Invisibility (absorbing glass and becoming transparent or merging with the absorbed material)
  • Peak Human/Enhanced/Supernatural/Absolute Condition

Variations[]

  • Charged Particle Absorption
  • Element Drain
  • Fantastic-Matter Absorption
  • Gas Absorption

Associations[]

  • Biological Absorption
  • Elemental Mimicry
  • Elemental Regeneration
  • Energy Assimilation
  • Matter Ingestion
  • Matter Melding
  • Metamorphic Arm
  • Solid Merging
  • Weapon Merge

Limitations[]

  • May be limited to how much one can absorb.
  • May have limited range, including touch only.
  • Absorption Immunity/Absorption Negation
